parameters.interpretation: Chosen phenomenological parameters, not fitted to fly physiology or Doom performance. LTD-only; no consolidation, recovery, extinction or prediction-error circuit.

protocol.controls: Same fixed DNp20/DNpe017 BCI in every arm. No trained or game-state-driven decoder.
protocol.reinforcement: A health decrease schedules 200 ms of +30 mV-equivalent PPL101 current starting next game tic.
protocol.shuffling: Circular shift of paired-arm delivered-US booleans, chosen with an independent seeded RNG. Actual delivered exposure is checked; early deaths can prevent dose matching.
protocol.headless: No sleep, viewer, compressed video or high-rate full-state serialization. RGB generated and sampled every tic.
protocol.experimental_unit: Independent game seeds and reset copies of one reconstructed male; not independent biological flies.
protocol.evaluation: Plasticity and all imposed reinforcement off; matched held-out seeds. Neural dynamics reset between episodes; learned efficacies retained.
protocol.retention: Quiet zero-drive simulated interval followed by reset of fast neural state. LTD-only persistence is a model property, not measured biological retention.
protocol.claim_gate: Vision pathway, conditioning, dose-matched comparisons, held-out improvement and reset control must all pass. A working runner is not proof of learning.

circuit.selection: All existing KC-to-MBON11 edges; no graph pruning or added connections.
circuit.compartment_assignment: Cell-type-level gamma1/peduncle inference; aggregate edges do not resolve receptor localization.
circuit.modulation: PPL101 outgoing edges deliver a transmitter trace to every recorded target. Only the specified KC-to-MBON11 efficacy response is modeled. Other target responses remain unknown.
circuit.baseline_difference: Two PPL101 cells use a modulatory channel rather than the baseline default fast excitatory sign.
